dateAssessment: The working Chardon calendar is August 21–22, DR 1748, from the session YAML. No month, day or year is independently spoken; Tuesday is the stated weekday during Kenzo’s first visit. Afternoon arrival, the evening meeting with Vola, the explicit next-morning skip and Chapterhouse lunch fit one overnight. The time extraction remains **compatible**, because the two earlier journey examinations are played retrospectively without a date: they could fall on arrival day or before it. Their historical visions have separate local clocks and do not extend elapsed adventure time. The proposed four-o’clock tea, future library loan and Illoria expedition are future plans.
